moneyProfitGroups.title: Profit by group
moneyProfitGroups.sub: Which categories and styles make money after their own costs and their share of ad spend — to decide what to restock, buy in bulk or stop.
moneyProfitGroups.adsOff: Ad spend is not spread over orders (setting costs.allocation), so profit here is before ads.

table.title: Group by group
table.sub: Each group includes everything under it. Profit = Sales − product cost + delivery charges − courier, fees, packaging and messages − ad share. Margin = profit ÷ Sales with a cost.
table.noCost: {amount} with no cost yet (left out of profit)
table.missing: {n} lines miss a cost part (courier, fee, packaging or ads): the profit is short of it
table.empty: No delivered orders in this period.
table.cut: Only the first {n} groups are listed; the CSV has every group.
